title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe pressure palette to the network app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 map colours nodes from red to blue; some colour-blind users cannot read it.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode, with a printed value on every node.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Nodes distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: the Colebrook-White friction factor
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; Swamee-Jain is off by up to 2.8 percent against Colebrook-White.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask how accurate the shipped friction factor is.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a general network solver for any number of loops
body:
## Problem
Session 3 solves exactly one loop with a hand-written Hardy Cross.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5: pipes and nodes as data, Newton on the node heads.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the learner edits a small network and sees the flows and pressures update.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 8-pipe, 3-loop network meets the roadmap checkpoint
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Reproduce the Target: a town network drawn over a day
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a town network with flow dots and pressure colours; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 24 frames of a 12-node town with pressure colours
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
